models_evaluated: sMMD (sampling-based maximum mean discrepancy) causal representation learning framework

links.outcome: Clinician decision accuracy and decision time with versus without AI support
links.effect: Clinician accuracy improved by 14.7% while decision time was reduced with the AI method.
links.quote: In human-AI evaluation, our method outperforms clinicians-in-training and large language models, and improves clinician accuracy by 14.7% while reducing decision time, enabling interpretable, real-time clinical decision support.
